strict_denominator_rule: Every attempted trajectory remains in the denominator.

strict_task_success.definition: mean(reward > 0) on the frozen held-out split

strict_success_auc.definition: trapezoidal area under strict success versus cumulative environment interactions

valid_call_rate.definition: valid expected calls divided by all expected call opportunities before deterministic stop
valid_call_rate.source: rollout_samples.*.jsonl reconstructed with run_agent.validate_response reason rules

invalid_call_reasons.definition: counts of MISSING_TOOL_CALL, MULTIPLE_TOOL_CALLS, UNEXPECTED_TOOL_NAME, INVALID_JSON_ARGUMENTS, ARGUMENTS_NOT_OBJECT, and INVALID_ARGUMENT_SCHEMA
invalid_call_reasons.source: rollout_samples.*.jsonl and sas_invalid_call structured log lines

process_compliance.definition: fraction with exactly search_catalog, inspect_items, check_kit, submit_bundle

final_reward.definition: mean and distribution of strict reward including invalid trajectories

cumulative_trainable_tokens.definition: cumulative sum of effective non-prompt loss-mask tokens

effective_masked_response_length.definition: trainable and masked response-token counts per optimizer step

optimization_diagnostics.definition: policy loss, gradient norm, sequence ratio mean/std, and clipping diagnostics
optimization_diagnostics.source: TensorBoard train/loss, train/grad_norm, train/ratio_*, and algorithm-specific clip metrics

wall_clock.definition: rollout, reward, advantage, train, and end-to-end seconds

peak_gpu_memory.definition: maximum allocated GPU memory per arm under the same process protocol
